name: The Huntress
source: The Huntress wants it all: love, family, and someone to help her butcher men in the forest. Is she human? Beast? No idea. But her arms are out of this world! Now, this loveable squirrel-eating lady is out of the woods and ready to let Cupid’s hatchet fly in her new search for companionship.
